title: Milking the niche: Microbial control of neonatal hematopoiesis
title_zh: 挤压细分领域：微生物对新生儿造血的调控
abstract: In this issue of Cell, Howard et al. reveal how the milk glycoprotein osteopontin shapes the neonatal microbiome to regulate hematopoiesis, promoting dendritic cell development and protection from severe respiratory infection. These findings uncover a maternal milk-microbiota pathway linking early-life nutrition to immune development and long-term disease susceptibility.
abstract_zh: 在本期《细胞》杂志中，Howard 等人揭示了乳糖蛋白骨桥蛋白如何塑造新生儿微生物组以调节造血，促进树突状细胞发育并预防严重呼吸道感染。这些发现揭示了母乳-微生物通路，将早期营养与免疫发育及长期疾病易感性联系起来。
